categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies outbound message validation in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents V2 transport buffer overruns and V1 transport aborts by enforcing message type and payload bounds on outbound traffic before queuing. Commit 4b10305dee notes that 'V1 aborts on a longer type, while V2 can overwrite the first payload byte or write past its encoding buffer', eliminating a dangerous failure mode in transport serialization.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Lacks the RPC label, and the small change to src/rpc/net.cpp only enforces the P2P limit in sendmsgtopeer.
categories.rationale: Updating sendmsgtopeer merely reflects the underlying P2P message constraints and does not alter RPC infrastructure or programmatic interface design.
